(329)dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas sreg pa hom gyi gzer ka bskal pa'i me chen bzhugs/(330)gtum chen 'jigs dus me dang gnam lcags thog/ba

tei:div.tei:p: (329)dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas sreg pa hom gyi gzer ka bskal pa'i me chen bzhugs/(330)

gtum chen 'jigs dus me dang gnam lcags thog /brgya byin rdo rje 'bar bas mtshon min pa'i// drag shul ri rab 'bum bsnyil nga ro can// bla ma kro dha lo korta la 'dud// bskal me 'bum 'dra'i byin za'i lces// rgyal 'gong dam sri rtswa sbur bzhin// zos te mi shigs 'od gsal dbyings// bskyil byed hom gyi gzer 'di'o// de la sreg pa hom gyi las ni/ drag po'i gnas dus su/ bkra mi shis pa'i sa sna dang drag po'i sa sna skyin po rnams sbyar ba las grub pa'i maṇḍal gru gsum/ rgyar mda' gang*/ dpangs sor lnga pa/ dug khrag gis dmar nag tu byug pa'i steng du ma traṃ gyi lto bar chos 'byung gru gsum/ zla gam gsum/ 'khor lo rtsibs (331) bzhi mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i lte bar rdo rje sngon po/ rtsibs dang mchan bzhi/ sgo bzhi rnams su thig le sngon po/ kha khyer rim gsum par khro bo'i rdo rje nag po rwa gdengs pas bskor ba'i kha tsher ma can gyi shing ngam/ dur khrod kyi 'gal dum lta bu'i shing las thab khung gru gsum pa rgyar sor nyi shu/ dpangs su sor gcig gis dman pa dug khrag gis sbags shing ro sol thal chen rnga mo dang bong bu'i sbangs kyis byugs pas brtsigs pa'i shar lho'i mtshams su me tshang bca'/ me srog 'dzin pa'i rdzas/ gong gi shing las grub pa'i yam shing mthe'u chung gi sbom khra tsam la srid du sor bcu gnyis pa rtsang gi dbyibs can/ rtse mo gnyis la dug khrag gis sbags pa rtsa ba'i rdzas/ 'gugs 'dren yid ches par byas pa'i ling ga rkang lag brgyangs te (mchangs )pa'i rnam pa bskrad ling gi dbyibs can dang*/ shog ling dang*/ 'bru nag gi zan ling (332) grangs mang*/ drag po'i rdzas sha sna bag phye bsres pa'i ril bu/ ba nad dbab rdzas sbal sbrul nya khyi bya phag sogs kyi sha dug sna dang bsres pa bsod pa'i rdzas/ lcags zangs rdo'i phye ma mar can myos pa'i rdzas/

mar nag dme mnol gyi khrag dang sbyar ba/ tsha ba'i rdzas til mar yungs dkar/ tsha ba gsum ste/ drag po'i rdzas bdun dang*/ mar khu la mi rta ba lang sogs srog chags sna tshogs kyi tshil mang bsres pa/ de rnams thod pa lcags snod gyo dum sogs drag po'i snod du blugs te ro ras sam phung re'i steng du me ltar 'bul rgyu nyung zad dang bcas tsho gnyis g.yas ngos su bshams/ yang na/ drag po'i rdzas nas tsha ba'i rdzas bar dang/ sha tshil sna tshogs/ til nag nyungs nag lan cha/ thal chen nomba'i lo ma/ rke tshe/ rnga mo dang bod bu'i sbang*/ ro skra/ mi rus/ khrag sna/ thun rdzas sogs bag phye dang sbags te ril bur dril/ (333) g.yon ngos su chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod/ khrag gi arghaṃ sngon du 'gro ba'i nang gi nyer spyod/ 'das ma 'das kyi dmar gtor sha khrag gis brgyan pa/ mdun du sman raka dgang blugs/ las bum/ thod rnga/ rdor dril/ me tog rlung g.yab/ ku sha gos zung*/ rdo sho'i so ci/ gdab kha'i yo byad rnams dang*/ lcags lang*/ lcags sgyed/ chang gar ma'am a rag mar nag bskol ma'i chas sogs nyer mkho rnams bsgrigs/ thab dang slob dpon bar du me yol baṃ yig dang gangs ri bris pa'ang bzhag go phrin las kyi gzhung tshogs mchod lhag ma yan song nas/ sgrub pa po drag po'i chas su zhugs/ dur khrod kyi ras la zhing chen bris pa'i stan la tsog bu'am mgar ba'i 'dug stangs kyis kha lhor phyogs pas snying rje khros pa'i sems dang ldan pas/ las bum gyi nang du hūm̐ las (334)khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bskyed bstim/ bzlas pa cung zad byas/ bum chu g.yon bskor gyis gtor zhing*/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du tri las gdon bgegs kyi sha khrag phung khams skye mched las byung ba'i mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas rnams so so'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs shing rang rang gi drag po'i las rab 'byams bsgrub par nus pa ngo bo sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shabda'i bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarb+pa pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥtha: oṃ āḥ(335)hūm̐ ma hā ba ling ta ta dzwa ba lingta bha la bha ti gu hya sa ma ye swā hāḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta sa manta maṇḍal hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ agne gdon bgegs dam sri 'byung po dzwa la raṃ/ zhes 'bul/ bsreg rdzas oṃ badzra shri gro bo lod gnod byed tri mā ra ya dza dza: zhes brlab/ spor sde thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung nas g.yon bskor du lan gsum bskor zhing*/ rtsa sngags bzlas te/ gdol pa/ bshan pa/ dme yugs kyi mi las byung ba'i ting lo sbar ba dang bcas/ oṃ agne ha bya ka bya dzaḥ gnod byed che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa dzwa la raṃ/ zhes me sbar/ oṃ agne gdon bgegs dam sri 'byung po dzwa la raṃ/ zhes rtsa skam cung zad bcug cing blugs gzar lan gsum gyis me gso/ hūm̐ gsum brjod de rlung g.yab kyis me sbar/ ku sha rtsa rtse ma nyams pa/ oṃ badzra sa twa aḥ zhes bzlas nas/ (336) oṃ: ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi zhing bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ zhes ku sha gnyis gshibs/ thog mar rtse mo lho ru bstan/ rim bzhin g.yon bskor gyis snga mas rtses phyi ma'i rtsa ba mnan mthar ku sha'i chun po ba glang gi rna ba lta bu'i rtse/ me las mthun gyi phyogs su bstan te g.yogs/ thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las drag po'i thab khung nag po zur gsum pa/ bang rim (337)gsum ldan kha khyer la khro bo'i rdo rjes mtshan pa zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa raṃ yig gis spras pa'i dbus su raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las drag po'i me lha nag po zhal gcig

phyag gnyis pa/ g.yon gundhe dang g.yas skyabs sbyin gyis phyag rgyas bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ gos nag po bgos shing srad bu nag po'i se ral kha 'phyangs pa/ me lce nag po'i 'od zer stong gis dkris shing*/ smin ma dang sma ra 'bar ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ lto ba 'phyang zhing (338)sbom la thung pa/ sha rgyas pa/ g.yas brkyang ba'i phyed skyil gyis ra skyes kyi steng na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa me mtshams nas badzra sa ma dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya/ rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya dang bcas la/ hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che// me lha drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// a la la te dgyes par mdzod// e hya hi bha ga wā na ma (339)hā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ shya ho: sa ma ya st+waṃ/ yagne dza dzaḥ agne dhe wa shri hūm̐ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ zhes spyan drangs shing gdan 'bul/ hūm̐/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /drag po'i don la dam tshig dgongs// gzi brjid che bas thugs rje ldan// bdag cag gus pas khyod phyag 'tshal/ oṃ agne ye de wa a ti pu ho: pra tītstsha hoḥ sa phyag rgya/ hūm̐/ rang srong me lha 'khor bcas la/ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// sgron me dri chab zhal zas sgra// 'bul gyis drag po'i phrin las mdzod/ oṃ agne ye de wa rā dza (340)arghaṃ pū dza hūm̐/ sogs nas shabda 'i bar gyis phyi mchod 'bul/ hūm̐/ drang srong chen pos sngon chad ma bstar ba'i// ting 'dzin dbang bsgyur zhal zas bdud rtsi 'di// dag cing gtsang mar sbyar te 'bul lags kyi// ye shes thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ oṃ agne de wā rā dza pū dza khā hi/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/

ma hā ba lingta khā hi/ ma hā rakta khā hi/ zhes nang mchod 'bul/ hūm̐/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// 'dod yon mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di// me lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ oṃ agne dāe bā rā dza ga na tsakra pū dza khā hi/ zhes tshogs (341)phud 'bul/ hūm̐/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /mnyam pa'i ngang las kun snang yang*// chos nyid ngang las ma g.yos pa'i// ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ byon zan ni/ me lha'i ljags rdo rje rtse gcig pa la raṃ/ dgang blugs kyi rtse la hūm̐ yig nag po re res mtshan par gyur/ oṃ agne ye swā hā/ brjod cing blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang ste pus mo'i kha las lag pa gnyis kyis mi 'da' bar lag gnyis mthe bong gang du bcug mthe'u chung sgreng ba'i khro bo'i khu tshur gyi phyag rgyas gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar zhing g.yon du bskor zhing*/ agne ye di bya di bya bi shuddhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya ba hā na ye/ bdag cag dpon (342)slob rgyu sbyor rnams la gnod par byed pa'i sdig sgrib bar gcod/ khyad par dam sri rgyal 'gong 'byung po che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul/ na mo rig pa'i rgyal po drang srong me lha chen po khyod kyis las thams cad byed pas sreg rdzas lha'i zhal du 'bul ba dang*/ me nyid ye shes kyi mer byin gyis brlabs nas bdag gi phrin las sgrub par mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag la gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thams cad brlag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyang lag g.yon gyis 'bul te yam shing ni/ oṃ agne ye bdag cag dpon slob sogs nas/ mā ra ya rbad/ ces pa'i bar gyis 'bul/ (343)mar khu/ oṃ agne ye bdag cag dpon slob sogs spel tshig gong dang 'dra bas dbul/ skyogs kyi nang du mar nag bkol tshad ran par byas/ shog ling gcig skam pas bzung nas steng du 'phyar/

dgug gzhug lan gcig gam gsum ci rigs par bya/ hoḥ drag po me lha gdangs pa'i zhal nang du// gnod byed 'byung po che ge mo 'di stobs kyi// lus srog mthu stobs thal bar bsregs byas nas// rjes med rlung la bskur ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ agne ye che ge mo'i lus srog mthu stobs thams cad mā ra ya dzwa la raṃ khā hi/ zhes pa'i rtsa ba'i rdzas 'bul/ hūm̐ agne rā dza 'khor bcas la// sman raka dpal bshos drag po'i rdzas// zhal (344)du stobs po bar chod bgegs// mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ khā hi/ oṃ badzra kro dha agne ye che ge mo dzā la raṃ ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces drag po'i rdzas nas tsha rdzas bar grangs su bcad de 'bul/ gang bzhin bstod pa bya/ hūm̐: me lha 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyis// gnod byed 'byung po bgegs kyi tshogs// lus pa med par tshar gcod pa'i// drag po'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ ces gsol ba btab/ ye shes me lha phar gshegs shar lho nas// tshur gzigs phrin las sgrub pa'i dpang po mdzod/ agne dzwa la dzwa la gatstsha mu/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ dam tshig me lha'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang*// bhrūm̐ las dbang drag (345)rol pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ sogs nas/ lha bskyed/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol yan grub mtshams/ oṃ shrī ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri ba ra arghaṃ pra titstsha swā hā/ zhes dang*/ pādyaṃ sbyar ba bcas kyis chu gnyis phul/ de nas phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa/ a ra li khā hi/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ hūm̐/ gnod byed dam sri 'byung po sgrol ba'i phyir// che mchog padma drag po 'khor bcas la// zhal zas tshogs ky-i mchod pa dam pa 'bul// 'chol ba'i khro rgyal zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ gha na tsakra kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes sogs 'bul/ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: sogs kyis bstod/ gtso 'khor kun kyang sku mdog rtsa ba'i zhal// mig sman mdog can shin tu (346)khro zhing rngams// stong zil ltar gnag 'tsher ba'i 'od 'phro ba// drag po'i las kun mdzad pa'i rnam par gyur/

ces gsal btab/ byon zan ni/ ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje rtse gcig pa la raṃ/ dgang blugs kyi rtse la hūm̐ yig nag po re res mtshan par gyur/ hūm̐/ chos nyid brdal ba chen po'i hom khung du// rig pa byang chub sems kyi me sbar te// gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i bags chags bsreg pa dang*// dbang drag lha tshogs thugs dam skong ba'i phyir// dug gsum sha khrag rdzas chen 'di 'bul gyi// mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las sgrub par (347)mdzod/ rtsa sngags bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang nas/ agne ye di bya di bya bi shuddhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na ye/ bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor rnams la gnod par byed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar gcod/ khyad par dam sri rgyal 'gong 'byung po a mu ka mā ra ya rbad/ lan gsum/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ bde chen chos dbyings sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sku: sogs bskul pa/ nas gdab las/ hūr thuṃ dza mā ra ya rbad/ bar gyis liṅga rnams dum bur gtubs la/ hūm̐: che mchog padma rdo rje gro bo lod// gnam sa lta bur gdangs pa'i zhal nang du// ye shes zhun chen mar nag ling ga dang*// sha khrag (348)tshil rus drug tshwa ro thal skra// tsha ba gsum dang til yungs gsod rdzas 'bul// gnod byed thal bar rlog la rtsad nas chod// mthu stobs nus pa drung phyung gnad la phob// zug gzer na tsha drag pos kha phung thongs// rgyab brten byed pa'i lha 'dre rang gshed phob// yid dang dbang po brgyal 'bogs myos su chug /srog rtsa dmar po dum bur bcad nas kyang*// dmigs pa'i gdon 'di myur du brlag gyur cig ces spyi bskul/ bye brag tu/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i zhing khams nas: rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: mtshan mchog brgyad dang rnam 'phrul (349)dpag tu med: zhi dang khro bo'i rnam 'gyur bsam mi khyab: lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje gro lod la:

sreg blugs drag po'i mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi: gnod byed 'byung po dam sri rgyal 'gong rnams: ming tsam brda tsam du yang mi grags pa'i// mngon spyod rtags kyi phrin las myur du sgrub/ rtsa sngags mjug tu/ oṃ badzra rakṣa sogs bsad sngags btags pa'i mthar/ bdag cag dpon slob sbyar bas yam shing dang mar khu 'bul/ de nas snum dang liṅga sogs sngar ltar la/ 'gugs pa dang bcas/ hoḥ che mchog padma drag po'i zhal nang du// gnod byed 'byung po a mu ka stobs kyi// lus srog (350)mthu stobs thal bar bsregs byas nas// rjes med rlung la bskur ba'i phrin las mdzod/ rtsa sngags dang bsad sngags sbrel mas liṅga 'bul/ de nas drag po'i rdzas nas tsha rdzas bar rnams rtsa sngags bsad sngags sham du/ gnod byed a mu ka'i lus ngag yid gsum mthu stobs nus pa thams cad mā ra ya dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces grangs su bcad de 'bul/ de bzhin du/ ham̐'u bhyoḥ thugs kar zla gam gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: gar gyi dbang phyug rta mchog he ru ka: padma gzi ldan rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum: sras dang sprul pa bsam mi khyab pa la: sreg blugs drag po'i sogs dang*/ sngags oṃ padmanta krita hya ghri ba hūm̐: la las (351)sngags btags pa dang*/ hoḥ dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i zhal nang du/ sogs 'bul tshul gong ltar/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ chos dbyings ye shes rnam snang gangs chen mtsho: rdo rje slob dpon buddha thod phreng rtsal: me long ye shes rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: mnyam nyid ye shes ratna thod phreng rtsal: sor rtog ye shes padma thod phreng rtsal: bya grub ye shes karma thod phreng rtsal: rigs bzhi'i ging chen mkha' 'grau'i 'khor dang bcas: phrin las bzhi sgrub sgo skyong bcas pa la: sreg blugs drag po sogs dang*/ sngags oṃ padma ta krita hya ghri wa hūm̐: oṃ badzra shrī gro bo lod sarba siddhi hūm̐: zhes bsnyen (352)sgrub gsham du las sngags sbyar ba dang*/ hoḥ thod phreng sde lnga rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ging*// sgo skyong pho nyar bcas pa'i zhal nang du/ sogs 'bul tshul gong ltar ro/ 'jug pa bde bar byed na/ dmigs pa'i gdon 'di myur du brlag gyur cig zhes pa'i 'phros su/ hūm̐/ dbang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: dpal chen rta mgrin rdo rje gro bo lod: sras dang sprul pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: sreg blugs drag po'i sogs dang*/ sngags bsnyen sgrub las gsum sbrel ma/ hoḥ dbang drag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal nang du/ sogs kyis 'thus so/ de nas thab kyi steng du lcags sgyed btsugs/ slang ngar mar nag bkol ba'i me lces sleb pa'i sa 'khor ling chen mo nam mkhar bla bres ltar brgyangs te (353) hūm̐ bhyoḥ bde chen chos dbyings sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sku: sogs thugs dam bskul/

gser skyems/ bden brdar 'gugs gzhug bya/ de nas/ hoḥ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ 'jam dpal sku'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ padma gsung gi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ bdud rtsi yon tan gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ phur pa phrin las kyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ ma mo rbod gtong gi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ rig 'dzin slob dpon gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ 'jig rten mchod bstod/ dmod pa drag sngags/ (354)dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dgongs su gsol/ gnod byed 'byung po che ge 'dis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa la bar du bcad de mdo sngags kyi sde rnams dkrugs shing mi mthun par byas so/ sngags 'chang rnal 'byor pa bdag la tho 'tshams so// 'gro ba rnams kyi sha khrag brkus shing sha khrag hab sha byas so// bsod nams dang mnga' thang nyams su bcug go /lo thog la sad ser btsa' than phab bo// mi phyugs la nad rim char ltar btang ngo*// khyad par du rgyu sbyor che ge mi nor 'khor g.yog dang bcas par mi 'dod sna dgus mnar ro// bdag (355)sogs rnams kyi gnod byed 'di la dang por khas ma nyes/ bar du lag gis ma nyes/ tha ma spyod pas ma nyes so// rgyal khams phung ba'i phung 'dre 'di nyid tshar gcod pa'i dus la babs pas/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams kyis legs nyes kyi stangs zungs (la )pa/ bden rdzun gyi shags phye/ mthu stobs nus pa'i rtsal bskyed la da lta nyid du tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod/ khyad par che mchog padma rdo rje gro bo lod/ dbang chen rta mchog rol pa/ yum chen padma gzi ldan/ ye shes kyi bya khyung ga ru ṭa/ buddha thod phreng rtsal/ badzra thod phreng rtsal/ ratna thod phreng (356)rtsal/ padma thod phreng rtsal/ karma thod phreng rtsal/ rigs bzhi'i ging chen yab yum/ gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/

'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro/ 'gugs 'ching sdom myos mdzad pa'i sgo ma/ sprul pa yang spul las byed dang bcas pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ nyi zla lta bu'i spyan gyis gzigs/ gnam sa lta bu'i zhal gdangs/ gangs ri lta bu'i mche ba gtsigs/ glog dmar lta bu'i ljags skyongs la/ ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyi nga ro drag po dang bcas te gdon bgegs 'byung po che ge g.yog 'khor sde dpung dang bcas pa da lta nyid du zhal du bzhes la lhag ma (357)tsam yang ma lus par sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod cig bsnyen sgrub las sngags sham du/ oṃ agne ye dzwa la raṃ khā hi/ zhes chang gar ma (blug)ldug thengs lan gsum dang bcas hom mchod rgyas par bya'o/ gshegs skyems ni byon zan ji lta ba bzhin 'bul/ hūm̐: che mchog padma drag po 'khor bcas la/ khyad par mchod pa pañtsa a mṛ ta// ma hā ba ling rakta mchod par 'bul// bzhes nas bla med dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs dang*/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha hi/ ma hā rakta khā hi/ ma hā ba lingta khā hi/ zhes sman raka dang gtor ma stob/ oṃ badzra tambu la ye swā hā/ so rtsi dang*/ oṃ badzra wast+ra ye swā hā sa gos zung 'bul/(358) 'gro ba'i don du rang byung 'od dpag med: bkra shis yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i sku: 'jig rten dbang bsgyur padma rgyal po'i sras: rdo rje gro lod rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pas bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyo: 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod nas: sogs bzlog pa tshar gcig 'phros/ bdag cag sems can las kyis mnar zhing gzir: ma rig dbang gis smin po rgyud lngar 'khyams: log rtog ngan pa'i dbang bsgyur 'gal 'khrul rnams: ye shes gzigs mnga' 'phags pa'i tshogs la bshags: yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/(359)/rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/

badzra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ dpang por bzhugs pa'i ye shes kyi/ me lha badzra sa mā dzaḥ slar yang dam tshig sems dpa' dang dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu gyur/ agne ye de ba rā dza arghaṃ pū dza hūm̐: sogs nas shabda 'i bar dang*/ hūm̐/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /mnyam pa'i ngang las kun snang yang*// chos nyid ngang (360) las ma g.yos pa'i// ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ zhes mchod cing bstod/ oṃ agne ye bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor rnams la gnod par byed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar gcod khyad par dam sri rgyal 'gong 'byung po a mu ka mā ra ya rbad/ zhes pas yam shing dang mar khu phul/ oṃ a gne ye gnod byed a mu ka'i lus ngag yid gsum mthu stobs thams cad mā ra ya dzwa la raṃ khā hi/ zhes pas rtsa ba'i rdzas dang*/ oṃ badzra kro dha agne ye a mu ka dzwa la raṃ ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pas drag po'i rdzas nas tsha rdzas bar dbul/ oṃ agne ye swā hā: lan bdun/ agne ye di bya di bya bi (361)shuddhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na ye/ bdag cag sogs spel tshig gong ltar sbyar ba lan gsum gyis gshegs skyems 'bul/ badzra tambu las so rtsi dang*/ wast+ras gos zung dbul/ gtor ma/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ sa brlab/ oṃ agne ye sa pa ri bā ra ma hā ba lingta pū dza khā hi/ lan gsum gyis 'bul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ rnal 'byor bdag cag sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/ oṃ agne ye arghaṃ pra titstsha swā hā/ nas shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ me ste bsreg bya sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/ sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin (362)za khyed kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs// ji bzhin dus su tshur byon zhing*// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/

oṃ agne ya hi gatstsha/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par gyur/ sgrub pa po rnams lag g.yas steng du byas/ srin lag sbrel nas gral gru gsum gyi tshul du/ hūm̐/ e yi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: sogs dang*/ sumbha ni brjod/ me long skabs yod kyang mi bzhag par dug khrag gi chus bsad pa'i thal ba thugs dam bskul zhing*/ zlog pa'i thal rdeb dang 'brel bar dgra phyogs su rlung la bskur ba'am/ yang na thal sol rnams snod ngan du brubs la mchod rten nam lam rgya gram du mnan no/ las byang gi mjug bsdu'o/ 'jam dbyangs mi pham gsung rab las/ dmigs bsal dgra (363)bgegs bsad pa la/ dgra la dmigs bya'i dri ma rjes pa dang*/ bgegs la gnas rten gyi sa sogs bsreg pa'i dug khrag gi (sgra mi rus bub ma )sogs kyis liṅga mi rus ldan pa grangs mang bsreg te/ lha rnams kyis dgra bgegs bkug nas mtshon gyis gtub ste sha khrag lhag med du rol bar bsam/ sngags gsham du/ dgra bgegs che ge mo ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes btags pa'i rdzas 'bul la brgya 'am stong la sogs pa grangs bsog mngon spyod kyis bskrad pa la khwa dang 'ug pa'i sgro gtso bor gyur pa'i rdzas la sbyin bsreg bya ste/ dmigs pa ni/ yaṃ las byung ba'i rlung dkyil nag po gzhu yi dbyibs can la gnas pa'i rnga mo sngon mo rlung gi shugs can la dmigs bya bskyon te sprul pa'i khro bo'i tshogs kyis ded nas lho yi phyogs su gshog skya rlung gis khyer ba ltar (264)phyi mig tsam yang blta ba'i dbang med par mtha' med du bskrad par bsam/ rtsa sngags gsham du/ tshe ge mo utstsha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes sbyar/ dbye ba'am/ nim pa'i lo ma sbrul shun khwa dang 'ug pa'i tshang bsres pa'i rdzas bsreg shing lha rnams kyis sprul pa'i bya rog dang 'ug pa'i mgo can rta dang ma he la zhon pa'i dbye yul rnams kyi snying la zhugs pas phan tshun shin tu mi mthun pa'i sems rtsub mos 'thab 'dzing mtshon gyis 'khrugs nas 'ur snying langs par bsam/

sngags gsham du/ che ge mo 'di dang che ge mo 'di gnyis/ bi dwe ṣa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes btags la bzla/ drag po'i 'gugs pa ni/ rda du ra dang ka ra wi ra khrag dang bcas pa'i me tog dmar po sogs rdzas sreg cing*/ rlung gi dky-il 'khor la gnas pa'i seng ge dmar po'i steng du bsgrub bya gcer (365)bu skra dkrol ba la sprul pa'i pho nyas lcags kyus snying la btab/ zhags pas mgul nas bcing ste rlung shugs kyis rang dbang med par 'ong bar bsam/ rtsa sngags la/ che ge mo ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes btags so/ rengs shing gnon pa'i las la (yung ba sdong ros na bla dang )phug ron sbal pa lug dang sna la sogs pa'i sha dang bag phye dang 'bru sna dang dug sna'i rdzas gang rnyed sreg cing*/ lha rnams dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa 'od zer ser po 'phro bar gsal ba'i mdun du sa gzhir dmigs bya bsgyel ba'i snying gar ri rab dang*/ de steng sna tshogs rdo rje/ de steng sa dkyil ri phran rol mtsho dang bcas pa kha thur du bstan pas mnan cing*/ steng 'byung rim ri rab lha'i pho brang bcas te ldang med du bsam la/ sngags gsham du/ che ge mo st+wambha ya ku ru laṃ: zhes (366) bzla/ ngag gnon na gzhan rengs pa dang 'dra la lce steng sa dkyil ri rab dang rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan par gsal gdab nas/ sngags gsham du/ che ge mo'i ngag braṃ bha na ku ru laṃ/ zhes bzlas so/ rmongs pa la'ang rengs pa dang 'dra la lha rnams kyi 'od nag pos dmigs bya'i lus ngag yid gsum 'o mar ru ma bzhin du nag thibs se rmug cing dran pa nyams par bsam la/ che ge mo mo ha ya nan/ zhes bzla/ smyo bar byed pa la/ rda du ra sogs dug khrag tsha ba'i mar khu dang sha chen dang bya rgod sha sogs sreg cing*/ lha rnams las smyo dug gi char bab pa dmigs bya'i snying gar thim pas dran pa nyams cing dbang med du smyo bar bsam la/ sngags gsham du/ che ge mo

unma da hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bzlas/ drag po'i cho 'phrul gtong ba la ltas ngan gyi srog chags kyi sha gtso bor gyur pa'i (367)sha sna dang dug khrag gi rdzas sreg cing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi sku las sprul pa'i pho nya 'jigs su rung bas dgra bo'i khyim thams cad ltas ngan gyi yo langs 'khrugs te than gyi dmag tshogs mun pa ltar gtibs par bsam la/ sngags gsham du/ li khrim raṃ ka ra rma ri she'u re'u/ he dun rtsa phob/ khyung rtsa he phaṭa/ zhes btags la bzla'o/ de yang spyir las so sor sgrub pa la thogs pa med pa'i rdzas de dag phul bas lha mnyes pa'i 'od zer gyis las gang 'dod grub pa dang*/ sngags dang dmigs pa 'dod gsol sogs 'das ma 'das gnyis kar kha bsgyur te sbyar dgos pa ni kun tu shes par bya'o/ rdzas rdzogs rjes me thun brdeg na/ dpal chen sku las me dpung rnam lnga 'bar: me lce khro chu yang sprul mtshon cha yis: (368)tshwa tshwa 'phros pas nad gdon sdig sgrib bsreg: bar chad gdon bgegs brlag cing bcom par gyur: drag sngags mthar/ gnod byed dam sri pho mo'i srog la raṃ raṃ: tsitta raṃ raṃ thul thul: dzñā na a na la tsakra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: sgrub pa la bar chad byed pa thams cad mā ra ya dzwa la raṃ raṃ utstsha ta ya phaṭa: sarba anta ra shintaṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa raṃ swā hā: zhes sbyar ro/ sgrub dkyil dang 'brel na/ rtsa sngags mthar phaṭa dzaḥ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du las kyi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par thon nas sbyin sreg gi las rim la 'jug par mos pa dang*/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'i skabs (369)gzhal yas khang gdan bskyed pa yan song mtshams/ dkyil 'khor nas tshom bu spyan drangs pa dang chab cig spyan 'dren dang sngags tsam gyis bzhugs su gsol/ lha bskyed bton la gsal gdab/ chu gnyis 'bul ba lan sngar ltar gshegs gsol skabs tshom bu slar bskyal ba khyad par ro/

dmigs yul gshin po'i don du chags chen 'khrul ba sbubs shig gi gshed 'dul byed na/ ye shes rab 'bar las/ drag po'i sbyin bsreg lha bskyed mchod de bskul: tshe 'das srog gcod dbugs len bla khyer dang : mdangs 'phrog za 'dre shi gshed gzugs la dbab: 'dzin sdom myos byed drag po'i thun gyis 'dul: zhes gsungs pas drag po'i sbyin bsreg gong du bshad pa ltar la/ 'dod gsol kha bsgyur/ tshe las 'das pa gson gyi dus su tshe la bar du gcod (370)cing gshin gyi dus su sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa'i za 'dre shi gshed thams cad/ zhes pa dang*/ gnod byed za 'dre shi gshed/ zhes dang*/ gnod byed 'byung po za 'dre shi gshed/ sogs skabs gang babs dang*/ hom mchod skabs dgongs su gsol/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ tshe las 'das pa la/ dang po nad kyi sna 'dren/ bar du gdon gyi tshang bca'/ tha ma nad la mi phan par byed/ shi kha dbugs sdud cing phung po bdag tu bzung*/ gshin po gnas mi bde zhing*/ gson po bkra mi shis par byed pa ma rig gdon gzugs su shar ba'i za 'dre shi gshed 'di rnams/ zhi bas 'dul du mi 'tshal bas/ snying rje khros pa'i drag shul 'bar ba (371)chen pos/ las ngan gyi rgyun bcad/ nyon mongs pa'i drwa ba gzhoms/ bag chags kyi sbubs bshig gzugs phung gdan du bzhes/ rnam shes he ru ka'i thugs klong du bstim ste ming tsam yang mi grags par mdzad du gsol/ khyad par che mchog padma rdo rje gro bo lod

sogs nas/ nga ro drag po dang bcas ste tshe las 'das pa'i thar lam la bar du gcod pa'i 'dre shi gshed 'khrul snang bag chags dang bcas pa da lta nyid du zhal du bzhes la sogs kha bsgyur gang dgos rigs pas 'phrul lo/ 'jigs dus zhugs kyis ri dang rgya mtsho bzhin// ldog med rdo rje ye shes 'bar ba'i mes// bar chod bdud (372)bgegs ming yang lhag med par// gzhil nas bde legs snang bas kun khyab shog /ces kun gzigs lnga pa chen po sogs tshad ma'i dam pa rnams kyi legs bshad bzhin kun mkhyen chen po ngag gi dbang pos rjes su bzung ba dpal chen 'dus pas bsdeb pa dge legs 'phel/// ///////////////////////////////
